meta.title: Channel bridge
meta.description: Connect and manage messaging channels from Message channels in the DSH sidebar. The bridge uses DSH to run isolated chat sessions. WeChat iLink sign-in and approvals use the existing QR and pairing code flow.

weixinBridge.title: WeChat bridge
weixinBridge.intro: Connect your personal WeChat to a private, persistent DSH conversation.
weixinBridge.limits.title: WeChat support
weixinBridge.limits.chat: Keep DSH running to receive WeChat messages. Sleep or exit interrupts the connection.
weixinBridge.limits.media: Private chats support text and attachments. Inbound and outbound attachments have a 1 MiB total limit per message. Group chats and broadcasts are unavailable.
weixinBridge.limits.owner: Only the DSH owner can scan, resume, or manually approve access. WeChat messages and agent tools cannot grant permission.
weixinBridge.steps.title: Connect in four steps
weixinBridge.steps.scan: Scan the QR code and confirm sign-in in WeChat.
weixinBridge.steps.pair: Send any text in WeChat to receive an 8-digit pairing code.
weixinBridge.steps.approve: Enter the pairing code below to approve the sender.
weixinBridge.steps.chat: Send another text in WeChat to start the conversation.
weixinBridge.status.title: Connection
weixinBridge.status.label: Connection status: {status}
weixinBridge.disabled.busy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
weixinBridge.disabled.offline: Reconnect to the network to continue.
weixinBridge.disabled.loading: Wait for connection status to load.
weixinBridge.disabled.stale: Status is out of date. Refresh it before changing the connection.
weixinBridge.disabled.connected: Already signed in. Disconnect first to change the account.
weixinBridge.disabled.notConnected: There is no connection or approval to clear.
weixinBridge.disabled.code: Enter the 8-digit pairing code received in WeChat.
weixinBridge.disabled.verification: Enter the verification code requested by WeChat.
weixinBridge.login.title: 1. Scan to sign in
weixinBridge.login.hint: The QR code is generated by the Host and is shown only in this panel. Do not share it.
weixinBridge.login.signedIn: WeChat is signed in. Continue with pairing below.
weixinBridge.login.waiting: Scan this QR code with WeChat.
weixinBridge.login.scanned: QR code scanned. Confirm sign-in in WeChat, then wait here.
weixinBridge.login.verify-code: WeChat requires an additional verification code.
weixinBridge.login.expired: This QR code has expired and is hidden. Generate a new one to continue.
weixinBridge.login.failed: Sign-in did not finish. Generate a new QR code and try again.
weixinBridge.login.succeeded: Sign-in confirmed. Waiting for the connection to become ready…
weixinBridge.login.qrAlt: WeChat sign-in QR code. Scan with WeChat before it expires.
weixinBridge.login.invalidQr: The QR image is unavailable or could not be loaded. Generate a new QR code.
weixinBridge.login.verificationHint: Enter the code from WeChat, not the 8-digit pairing code used below.
weixinBridge.login.verificationFailed: That verification code was not accepted. Check WeChat and try again.
weixinBridge.users.title: 2–3. Pair and approve senders
weixinBridge.users.hint: Send a text in WeChat first. Each sender must provide the 8-digit pairing code sent to their account.
weixinBridge.users.emptyDisconnected: Sign in first. Your request will appear here after you send a text in WeChat.
weixinBridge.users.emptyConnected: No pairing requests yet. Send any text in WeChat to receive a pairing code.
weixinBridge.users.pairingHint: Confirm the sender's identity before entering their pairing code.
weixinBridge.users.pairingSent: A pairing code was sent in WeChat.
weixinBridge.users.pairingExpired: The pairing code has expired. Send a new text in WeChat to receive a fresh code.
weixinBridge.users.pairingFailed: The pairing code could not be delivered. Send a new text in WeChat to retry.
weixinBridge.users.onlyOne: Another user is already approved. Revoke that access before approving a different user.
weixinBridge.users.revokedHint: To request access again, send a new text in WeChat and use the new pairing code.
weixinBridge.users.deliveryFailed: The latest message could not be processed or delivered. Check the connection, then resend the text in WeChat.
weixinBridge.users.sessionPending: Approved. Send another text in WeChat to create your conversation.
weixinBridge.users.historyHint: Each user's DSH session persists independently. Revoking access or disconnecting does not delete conversation history.
weixinBridge.confirm.disconnectBody: This stops receiving and clears the saved WeChat credentials and all approvals. DSH conversation history is kept. You will need to scan and pair again.
weixinBridge.confirm.revokeBody: This user will no longer be able to chat through the bridge. Their DSH history is kept. Restoring access requires a new pairing code and your approval.
weixinBridge.details.title: Read-only connection details
weixinBridge.details.noModel: No model selected. Choose one in DSH settings before chatting.
weixinBridge.details.localTime: Times are shown in your local time zone.
weixinBridge.replies.failureNotice: {count} replies failed or have an unconfirmed delivery result. They were not automatically resent. Check the conversation history in DSH before taking further action.
weixinBridge.errors.offline: You are offline. Reconnect to continue; status checks resume automatically.
weixinBridge.errors.network: Cannot reach DSH. Check the connection and keep DSH running, then refresh status. If an operation was interrupted, refresh before retrying it.
weixinBridge.errors.unauthorized: This DSH login has expired (HTTP 401). Reopen the authenticated DSH page, then refresh status.
weixinBridge.errors.forbidden: Owner access is required (HTTP 403). Open DSH as its owner, then refresh status. No permission has been granted here.
weixinBridge.errors.timeout: DSH did not reply in time. Refresh status before retrying; the Host may still have completed the operation.
weixinBridge.errors.server: The Host could not complete the request. Keep DSH running and refresh status before retrying.
weixinBridge.errors.invalidResponse: DSH returned an unexpected response. Refresh status; if it continues, check that the bridge Host and Client versions match.
weixinBridge.errors.hostUnavailable: The bridge Host endpoint is unavailable. Check that the plugin is enabled in DSH, then refresh status.
weixinBridge.errors.conflict: The connection changed while this request was running. Refresh status and try again.
weixinBridge.errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then refresh status and try again.
weixinBridge.errors.failed: The operation could not be completed. Refresh status and try again.
weixinBridge.errors.invalidPairing: The pairing code was not accepted. Enter the 8-digit code received by this user in WeChat.
weixinBridge.errors.pairingExpired: The pairing code has expired. Send a new text in WeChat for a fresh code, then try again.
weixinBridge.errors.approvalConflict: Only one user can be approved. Revoke the current user's access before approving someone else.
weixinBridge.errors.loginExpired: The sign-in request has expired. Generate a new QR code.
weixinBridge.errors.loginFailed: WeChat sign-in failed. Generate a new QR code and try again.
weixinBridge.errors.verificationFailed: WeChat could not verify this code. Check the code in WeChat and try again.
weixinBridge.errors.connection: The WeChat connection encountered an error. Try resuming it or sign in again if requested.
weixinBridge.errors.clipboard: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select and copy the session ID manually.
weixinBridge.errors.model: Select an available model in DSH settings before chatting.
weixinBridge.notice.loginStarted: A new sign-in request is ready. Scan the QR code before it expires.
weixinBridge.notice.loginVerified: Verification submitted. Confirm any remaining prompt in WeChat and wait here.
weixinBridge.notice.loginCancelled: Sign-in cancelled. You can generate a new QR code when ready.
weixinBridge.notice.paused: Receiving paused. Existing DSH history is unchanged.
weixinBridge.notice.resumed: Connection resumed. Check the connection status above.
weixinBridge.notice.disconnected: Disconnected. Saved credentials and approvals were cleared; DSH history was kept.
weixinBridge.notice.approved: Approved. Send another text in WeChat to start your conversation.
weixinBridge.notice.revoked: Access revoked. DSH conversation history was kept.
weixinBridge.channels.title: Message channels
weixinBridge.channels.configHint: Saving replaces the channel configuration and pauses receiving. Enter the required values again when changing it. Stored credentials stay hidden.
weixinBridge.channels.configInvalid: Enter valid values for the configuration fields or paste a JSON object.
weixinBridge.channels.allowedHint: Enter one platform sender ID per line. An empty list blocks all senders.
weixinBridge.channels.wildcard: Enter individual sender IDs. The wildcard * is unavailable.
weixinBridge.channels.accessNeedsChange: Enter a change to the allowed sender IDs.
weixinBridge.channels.qrAlt: Channel QR code. Scan it with the messaging app.
weixinBridge.channels.disconnectHint: Disconnect and remove the credentials and allowed senders for this channel? DSH conversation history is kept.
weixinBridge.channels.uncertain: Delivery could not be confirmed for {count} replies. Check the DSH conversation before resending.
weixinBridge.channels.accessBeforeConnect: Add an allowed sender before connecting.
weixinBridge.features.title: Reply options
weixinBridge.features.repliesHint: Options take effect on platforms that support the corresponding delivery mode.
weixinBridge.features.sessionHint: Open a conversation to review its replies or approve a pending tool call.
